description: Start a job to clean up one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Retopology: fewer, tidier faces, with an optional face target, quads, and UVs in the same pass (uv_in_same_pass). Price by version: v3.0 50 Gold (default), 55 Gold with quads, v2.0 45 Gold, v1.0 15 Gold. First call chargen_quote_3d_cleanup, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. The result is an FBX file, so a later split by name (GLB only) cannot use it. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

face_limit.description: Target number of faces, from 100 to 200000.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

keep_textures.description: Keep the textures on the result (default true). Free.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

quads.description: Quad faces instead of triangles (default false). Costs 5 Gold more on v3.0.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_cleanup. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

uv_in_same_pass.description: Also unwrap UVs in the same pass (version v3.0 only). Free.

name: chargen_edit_3d_cleanup
title: Clean up 3D model
